execution.storage: streamed files and direct DuckDB; no full resident view

legend.authority: Display artifacts and viewer edits never replace import or contribution data; colors do not indicate physical error severity.
legend.duplicate_face_identity: A resave that reorders indistinguishable duplicate faces cannot recover their individual source face IDs from vertex triples alone.

fields.coordinates: source float32 widened to float64, then the recorded display-only transform
fields.rejected_vertex_values: area, weight and vertex statuses still describe the source vertex, which may also belong to usable faces
fields.scalar_raw_area: authoritative source vertex area, in unknown source-coordinate squared units
fields.scalar_source_corner: original zero-based corner 0, 1 or 2 of the rejected source face
fields.scalar_vertex_status: 0=finite-position; nonfinite positions have no display location
fields.scalar_weight: dimensionless triangle-area-mean-one-v1 weight; not a solver weight
fields.source_digits: four successive 16-bit source row ID digits, least significant first, each exactly representable in binary32

legend.omission_access: Authoritative source vertex and face row queries retain all nondisplayable records; no coordinates are invented.

precision.viewer_preservation: requires a separate measured viewer round-trip report

legend.source_normals: retained in authoritative data; omitted from PLY views to avoid viewer normalization implying measurement preservation
legend.topology: Every usable source face retains winding and multiplicity after index remapping; source maps bind original export row order.

transform.meaning: display-only; not calibration or physical units

weight_ramp.measure: raw accumulated vertex area divided by complete eligible maximum
